items: Tables in Excel, nothing in Word

slides.b: One section per objective, in the same order as Chapter One. Easy to mark, easy to write.
"110 of 120 questionnaires returned, 92%." One line before any table.
Every table gets a number, a title and two sentences on what it shows. Don't repeat every figure.
"This agrees with..." or "Unlike...". Name the studies from your Chapter Two.
Half a page that answers each objective. Chapter Five builds on it.

Tell Toso your objectives and paste your tables. Get a structured results chapter to work from.
